picks.title: Epic’s new games launcher is ‘vibe coded’
picks.rationale: A major storefront openly shipped a client it built with AI-assisted coding. It is a concrete new release, and the bug warning is a direct signal about AI-built production software.
picks.excerpt: “We used AI as a tool for this.”

picks.title: Players Are Furious About Total War: Shogun 2's AI-Upscaled 'Enhanced' Edition
picks.rationale: A first-party remaster drew a backlash over genAI-upscaled art. It shows what happens to an asset pipeline when players can spot AI enlargement.
picks.excerpt: Steam users say it runs worse, looks worse, adds more bugs, and clearly used genAI to enlarge the artwork

picks.title: Playgama launches a suite of tools that lets AI agents analyze, refine, and update games on their own
picks.rationale: A new tool launch: agent tooling that analyzes, patches and publishes web games on its own. Of the five picks, this is the one a developer can act on most directly.
picks.excerpt: Playgama launches a suite of tools that lets AI agents analyze, refine, and update games on their own and publish on Playgama Sandbox.

picks.title: The Legend of Zelda: Link's Awakening's Nintendo Switch remake now has a PC port if you can stomach an "almost exclusive use of AI"
picks.rationale: A new AI-built port, and the first one of a Switch-era game rather than a retro recompilation. That raises the bar on what AI-assisted porting can now reach.
picks.excerpt: Something like this is way beyond my skill set

picks.title: The Blood of Dawnwalker lead actor reminds us why AI will always struggle to replicate human performances: "They need to have their own ideas"
picks.rationale: A lead performer on a current AAA RPG speaks about AI voiceover, a perspective this section has not run yet. It is the weakest pick, chosen because no other fresh candidates were left after dedup.
picks.excerpt: As the use of AI ever increases, the lead actor from The Blood of Dawnwalker reminds us what the technology doesn't replicate.
